up-lynx: lynx, the text web browser, for UP-Term

Contents: bin/lynx, etc/lynx.cfg, etc/lynx.lss, share/man/man1/lynx.1, licenses/lynx.
Licence: GPL v2; see LICENSES.txt.

Needs up-term.lha installed first (version 1.0 or newer); these files were part of it before the
slim base. It installs them at the same paths in UP-Term: (bin, etc, share, licenses): no new drawer, no
change of the path. In an UP-Term window, in vsh:
  lynx -version

Install: run Install (Installer) or, with upkg, install up-lynx. Uninstall takes the package out
again; the UP-Term Uninstall runs it first.
